og_title: Terracotta Glass Shape Planter | Handmade India – Pipihiri
og_description:
The Pipihiri Terracotta Glass Leg Planter combines traditional craftsmanship with a modern aesthetic. Inspired by tribal patterns, its intricately carved design is paired with a minimal paint job, offering the perfect balance of detail and simplicity. Handcrafted from natural terracotta and finished in a deep black color also this planter adds a contemporary look to any space.
This product is handmade and each piece is unique! Due to the differences in displays of computers/laptops/phones, the colours on your screen may vary marginally from the actual colours of the product.

Material: Terracotta

Color: Black and Yellow

Use: Planter

Size: 4.5*4.5*4.5 Inchs. Approx

Care: Wash directly with running water using your hands. Do not use any soap or detergent
